name: Can homeowners supply their own plumbing fixtures for a remodel?

mainEntity.name: Can homeowners supply their own plumbing fixtures for a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can choose your own fixtures, but you must ensure they match your plumbing rough-in specifications. Before purchasing, verify whether your sink uses a single-hole, 4-inch center-set, or 8-inch widespread faucet. For showers, confirm whether the trim kit matches the existing or planned rough-in valve inside the wall, as brand valves are rarely interchangeable. Homeowners often purchase finish fixtures directly or coordinate selections through their remodeling contractor to prevent sizing mismatches and construction delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, homeowners can provide fixtures, provided they verify that specifications, valve compatibility, and hole drillings match the rough-in plumbing and countertop layout.
